regions.today: Sunny spells, and a scattering of light showers. Highest temperatures of 18 to 22 degrees, with light to moderate southwest winds.
regions.tonight: A dry start tonight before rain spreads from the west and southwest through the night. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 13 degrees in light to moderate southerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: A rather wet start to the day, though the rain will become patchier and more intermittent during the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 16 to 21 degrees in light to moderate southerly winds.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Wednesday. Low on Thursday.
